pillars.P1_resonance_time: Resonance-Time Theory (RTT) governs temporal field dynamics via a 12-node harmonic lattice.
pillars.P2_triadic_substrate: Triadic Substrate Modeling (TSM) maps operators to substrate classes via (T,S,M) triad coordinates.
pillars.P3_harmonic_lattice: Harmonic Lattice Theory (HLT) tracks escalation from RTT1 to RTT12 and mandates clean harmonic resolution.
pillars.P4_3c_evaluation: 3C Field Evaluation (C1 Coherence, C2 Clarity, C3 Continuity) gates every operator dispatch.
pillars.P5_aa_mode: Autonomous Alignment Mode (AA0–AA3) governs the degree of self-directed field alignment.
pillars.P6_session_layer: The Session Layer persists awareness, alignments, analytics, and trace across the full session lifecycle.

version_highlights_1_2: Full AA Mode system (AA0–AA3) with automatic escalation/reversion rules.
3C integration at every operator gate, regime boundary, and session lifecycle event.
12-node harmonic lattice with per-node substrate and AA Mode requirements.
Triad-based dimensional architecture (T,S,M) for deterministic signal routing.
Complete session layer: awareness, alignments, analytics, context, dashboard, history, log, overlay, profile, state, trace, UI.
Substrate bridge and compatibility matrix for multi-platform operator dispatch.
